tables.title: Gondolas + Shippers + Displays
rows: Product(s) ordered separately; Product qty - 50 LED-XXT8
Screw-in Retrofit w/ Horizontal & Base-down Socket Positions (countertop display)
notes: The catalog has no table on this spread; each row is one labelled item (name, size, part number) and the 'Notes' column carries the bracket caption printed beneath the group it belongs to: 'PRODUCT(S) ORDERED SEPARATELY' (left page: both gondolas and the T8 shipper; right page: LED-9800, LED-9900, LED-9750-G2) or 'PRODUCT(S) INCLUDED W/ DISPLAY' (RP-LBI-G1-1F-2X-DISPLAY and SL-9101)
Sizes are printed in capitals as W x D x H style triplets, e.g. '24 IN x 14 IN x 78 IN'; the catalog does not label which dimension is which
'PRODUCT QTY - 50 LED-XXT8' is printed under the FlexColor T8 shipper: the shipper holds 50 FlexColor T8 tubes (XX = wattage); the rendered tubes are labelled '15W | LED-15T8-FCAB48-G4'
Words in parentheses in the Item column ('countertop display', 'display') are added for clarity and are not printed in the catalog

footnotes: Ordered separately: LED-9902, LED-9903, LED-FCT8-M, LED-9800, LED-9900, LED-9750-G2
Included with the display: RP-LBI-G1-1F-2X-DISPLAY, SL-9101

extras.title: Page note
extras.text: No application photo exists on this spread; all images are product renders/cutouts on white. Recommended hero: the 3 ft gondola (LED-9903) cutout, with the displays as a gallery.

extras.title: Gondola contents as rendered
extras.text: The gondola renders show boxed Bollard Retrofit and Post Top Retrofit lamps (3 ft gondola: one shelf of Bollard Retrofit then two of Post Top Retrofit; 2 ft gondola: two shelves of Bollard Retrofit then two of Post Top Retrofit); the 3 ft gondola's bottom shelf shows six LED Work Site String Light boxes. Boxes are illustrative merchandising; products are ordered separately.
